narrative.overview:
A dataset card is a page of a codebook: variable name, dotted leader, type. The whole interface is set the way printed data documentation is set, on warm paper, in ink, with one red rubric. It is flat, ruled, and square, and it reads as a document a researcher already knows how to read.

The system is quiet and dense where the data is, and plain and roomy where the instructions are. Two typefaces split the world in two: Courier Prime is the user's own material quoted exactly, and Libre Franklin is Crosswalk speaking. That split is how the interface shows what was read from the user's machine and what was not.

The system refuses the grey dotted node-editor canvas with rounded cards and a blue accent. The canvas is unmarked paper, cards are white leaves with ink borders, and nothing is blue.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, white leaves, ink rules, one red rubric.
Square corners everywhere, 1px ink borders, a 3px double rule under every heading that opens a list or a panel.
A dotted leader wherever a label meets its value.
Courier Prime for anything verbatim from the user's files or terminal, Libre Franklin for everything else.
Shadow only on things that move or open above the paper.

rules.name: The Rubric Rule
rules.body: Rubric means one of three things: the active column, an error, or a destructive action. It is never decoration, never a brand accent, and never the focus ring.

rules.name: The Live Rule
rules.body: Green appears only as the dot of the live connection state. When the connection drops the dot becomes a hollow Mute ring and the word changes to "Reconnecting", so the state never rests on colour alone.

rules.name: The Verbatim Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime means "copied exactly from the user's files or terminal": dataset names, column names, commands, the device code, and device host names. Everything else is Libre Franklin, including the wordmark and project names.

rules.name: The Untouched Name Rule
rules.body: Column and dataset names are never uppercased, title-cased, or otherwise altered. A name too long for its row is truncated with an ellipsis and shown whole in its entry. A blank name is shown as "(no name)".

rules.name: The Italic Type Rule
rules.body: A column's type is set in italic Libre Franklin at the end of the leader, in Mute. Italic is not used for emphasis anywhere else.

rules.name: The Loose Leaf Rule
rules.body: Shadow belongs only to draggable cards and the open column entry. Static panels, forms, lists, error boxes, and the top bar have none.

rules.name: The Double Rule Rule
rules.body: A card header, a panel heading, and a section heading that opens a list all end in the same 3px double Ink rule. A single Hair rule is for divisions inside what the double rule opened.

rules.name: The Leader Rule
rules.body: Wherever a label meets a value on one line they are joined by a dotted leader: column name to type, measure to figure, project to its count and date.

dos: Do set anything copied from the user's files or terminal in Courier Prime, exactly as it was written.
Do join a label to its value with the dotted leader whenever they share a line.
Do close every card header, panel heading, and list heading with the 3px double Ink rule.
Do keep every box square with a 1px Ink border.
Do use the 2px Ink outline, offset 2px, for focus on every control.
Do keep row height at 30px and card width at 304px, taken from the shared layout constants.
Do make a destructive action a two-step: a text link or icon first, then a Rubric button beside a button that keeps things as they are.
Do write copy in plain sentences with no em dashes.
Do pair every colour state with a word or shape change.
donts: Don't use Rubric for anything except the active column, an error, or a destructive action.
Don't use green for anything except the live status dot.
Don't uppercase, title-case, or otherwise alter a column or dataset name.
Don't set the wordmark, project names, or interface text in Courier Prime.
Don't round a corner. The live status dot is the only round shape.
Don't put a shadow on a static panel, form, list, or message.
Don't draw a grid, dots, or any pattern on the canvas. It is plain Paper.
Don't add a blue accent or a second accent colour.
Don't show a cell value anywhere. Cards and entries hold names and profiles only.
